title: Provisional/Manual Inspection — 5 Repos
objective: Inspect 5 repos flagged 'require manual inspection' and decide if they have unique capabilities

repos.name: TerraFusion-Valuator-Pro-Studio
repos.stack: Next.js + Rust crates (valuator-core, market-analyzer, risk-assessor, valuation-service)
repos.purpose: Standalone property valuation demo with Rust core engine and 3-agent swarm pipeline (Valuation -> Market -> Risk)
unique_capabilities: Rust valuation core (skeleton, not production-grade)
Comparable sales generator with GLA/bedroom/bathroom adjustments (simplistic formula)
Swarm pipeline UI components (dispatch-center, pipeline-history, network-topology)
repos.canonical_coverage: All concepts (AVM, comps, risk scoring) already in TerraFusion.AI project. Rust code is trivial stubs.
repos.disposition_rationale: Prototype demo. Rust crate is a skeleton with simplistic formulas. All domain concepts exist in canonical .NET stack. Keep as reference, archive.

repos.name: WashingtonForge
repos.stack: Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript + MapLibre GL + pnpm + Vitest
repos.purpose: Next-generation frontend prototype — full assessor workbench UI with GIS cockpit, AI pilot assistant, glass morphism design system
unique_capabilities: TerraPilot tool registry with RBAC + risk policy engine (mode locking, claims, risk tiering, supervisor approval)
Glass morphism material design system (glass-button, glass-card, matte-card, premium-tooltip)
GIS cockpit with MapLibre GL, filter panels, selection management
Data ingestion pipeline UI (upload, mapping, validation, preview, publish)
Comprehensive typed API client matching .NET backend domain model
Ratio study components (run-study-modal, charts, results)
Design tokens (styles/tokens.css)
repos.canonical_coverage: Canonical frontend is React 18/Vite with different UI approach. WashingtonForge has the glass morphism design system the user wants.
repos.disposition_rationale: Contains the most mature frontend design work. TerraPilot RBAC framework and glass morphism components should be ported to canonical frontend during Shell Phase 5. V0_SCOPE.md explicitly states this is a UI/UX spike.
repos.extraction_target: Phase 5 (Shell Integrity Recovery) — port design system and pilot framework

repos.name: MLS_to_TOTAL
repos.purpose: Placeholder for MLS-to-TOTAL data bridge (never implemented)
repos.disposition_rationale: Empty repository with no commits. No code, no value.

repos.name: TaxI_AI
repos.stack: Express/Node.js + React/Vite + Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL + multi-LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity)
repos.purpose: Most feature-complete Benton County assessor prototype — working multi-agent system, PACS data import, property stories, market prediction, data lineage
unique_capabilities: FTP data processor for PACS data (CSV/fixed-width/XML/JSON)
Data lineage tracker with field-level provenance
Property story generator with multi-LLM fallback
Enhanced market prediction model (year-over-year forecasting with confidence)
Washington state validation rules (wa-validation-rules.ts)
Appeals management service
Voice search for properties
Extension/plugin framework with working registry
ArcGIS integration service
Property insight sharing (QR codes + PDFs)
Hierarchical agent command structure
Assessor workflow engine
repos.canonical_coverage: Canonical .NET backend has service shells for these domains but TaxI_AI has richer business logic implementations. The domain-specific rules (WA validation, FTP PACS import, data lineage) would be valuable ports.
repos.disposition_rationale: Richest domain-specific prototype. Business logic for FTP/PACS import, data lineage, WA validation rules, appeals, and market prediction should be ported to .NET backend when those domain modules mature. Keep as reference.
repos.extraction_target: Future phases — port domain services to .NET backend as each module matures

repos.name: terra-magic-wand
repos.stack: React + Vite + TypeScript + Supabase Edge Functions + Tailwind
repos.purpose: Marketing/demo landing page with basic tax calculator, GPT chat via Supabase, and map visualization
unique_capabilities: Supabase Edge Function for OpenAI streaming chat
Basic land value tax calculator (value * rate)
GPT Suite scaffolding (chat, document gen, knowledge base, session manager)
repos.canonical_coverage: All concepts trivially implemented. Canonical stack has better AI services, tax calculation, and mapping.
repos.disposition_rationale: Marketing demo site with trivial implementations. Nothing unique that isn't better-covered by canonical stack.

summary.key_finding: WashingtonForge contains the glass morphism design system and TerraPilot RBAC framework needed for Phase 5 shell work. TaxI_AI contains the richest domain-specific business logic (WA validation rules, PACS FTP import, data lineage, appeals). Both should be kept as reference until their capabilities are ported to the canonical stack.
